102: Windows keeps copies of all previously installed device driver packages from Windows Update and other sources, even after installing newer versions of drivers. This task will remove older versions of drivers that are no longer needed. The most current version of each driver package will be kept.
202: Windows keeps copies of all previously installed device driver packages from Windows Update and other sources, even after installing newer versions of drivers. This task will remove older versions of drivers that are no longer needed. The most current version of each driver package will be kept. This task will also remove state used by devices that have not been detected on this system for a long period of time.
